items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It wasn't Walter Page's Blue Devils? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that could have been.

ctx.x: I'm pretty sure that was his first trip, too. He might have heard them before, but I know this was really my first trip. Now, I had heard Clarence Love, you know, like when I was in school down there. But see, now, when I was around home, the folks didn't let me go out to no dances or anything like that, see, so I didn't get a chance to catch Benny -- I caught Benny Moten one time. Was it Benny? I thought it was Benny because -- I do know this, that Jimmy Rushing was with the band. That's the reason I assumed it…
It wasn't Walter Page's Blue Devils?
Well, that could have been. That could have been, because Jimmy Rushing -- I remember --he sang with a megaphone and you know, a megaphone they put up to their mouth and sing through it?
